features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 STR; +2 CHA; -2 WIS.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size; no size-based adjustments.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with gria subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-foot land speed. Limited natural flight is a separate movement component below, not unrestricted always-on flight.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common, Draconic. High-Intelligence options: Banganese, Giant, Goblin, Ignan, Seeq, Terran.

features.name: Weakened Flight
features.description: While wearing light or no armor and bearing no more than a light load, natural flight at land speed (30 feet) with clumsy maneuverability. Fly for CON bonus rounds at a time without checks. Each further round requires a Constitution check at DC 10 + 2 for each extra round. After a flight, must rest for twice the number of rounds flown before flying again. The source does not explicitly state a minimum number of no-check rounds for negative or zero Constitution bonus.

effects.textValue: speed=land speed; maneuverability=clumsy; only light/no armor and <=light load; CON bonus rounds then escalating CON DC; rest 2x rounds flown

features.name: Fearless
features.description: +2 racial saving throws against fear spells and effects.

features.name: Stubborn
features.description: +2 racial Will saves against illusion spells and spell-like abilities. If the save fails and duration exceeds one round, receive a second save one round later at the original DC to end effect early. Only one similar reroll ability may be used in a single round; can try another next round if first fails.

condition.description: Illusion school spell or spell-like ability

effects.textValue: Second save 1 round after failed illusion save; same DC, duration >1 round; no combining same-round reroll abilities

features.name: Athleticism
features.description: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics skill checks.

features.name: Diplomatic
features.description: +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy skill checks.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: +2 racial bonus on Survival skill checks.

features.name: Martial Background
features.description: Gain Weapon Focus at level 1 for any one weapon in which this character is proficient; player selects the weapon, feat prerequisites and catalog identity must be checked.

effects.textValue: Weapon Focus (one selected proficient weapon) at first character level

features.name: Destructive
features.description: +2 racial bonus on sunder combat maneuver checks.

features.name: Weapon Familiarity
features.description: Proficient with knight sword and longbow (including composite longbow).

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far as a hume in dim light.

features.name: Bestial
features.description: +2 racial Perception bonus; replaces Diplomatic.

features.name: Desert Runner
features.description: +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue, exhaustion, or harmful effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments. Replaces Weapon Familiarity.

effects.textValue: +4 racial CON checks/Fortitude saves versus named hazards

features.name: Dual Minded
features.description: +2 bonus to all Will saves; replaces Fearless and Weapon Familiarity.

features.name: Erdane Guardian
features.description: +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Knowledge (geography) checks, with both treated as class skills. Replaces Athleticism and Survivalist.

features.name: Orc Ferocity
features.description: Once daily, when reduced below 0 HP but not killed, remain able to act for 1 round as though disabled. At end of next turn fall unconscious and begin dying unless healed above 0 HP. Replaces Weapon Familiarity.

effects.textValue: Once/day at HP below 0 but alive: act 1 round as disabled; fall dying at end next turn unless HP above 0

features.name: Fleet-Footed
features.description: Run as a bonus feat, and +2 racial initiative checks. Replaces Survivalist and Martial Background.

features.name: Skymaster
features.description: +2 to Fly and Pilot skill checks. Replaces Athleticism and Survivalist.

features.name: Heritage Cave Wyrm Alternate Movement

features.name: Heritage Draconic Ability Scores

features.description: +2 DEX; +2 CHA; -2 WIS.

features.name: Heritage Ocean Wyrm Alternate Movement
